sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是档案档案室出品的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode involves a crime against children.
sentences.zh: 本期节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪。

sentences.en: It may not be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 内容可能不适合所有听众。

sentences.en: It was a scorching hot morning on Monday February 22 1993, when married couple Ron and Dina, not
sentences.zh: 那是1993年2月22日星期一的一个酷热清晨，一对化名为罗恩和迪娜的夫妇

sentences.en: their real names, drove along the Brand Highway towards the small Western Australia town of
sentences.zh: 开车沿着布兰德高速公路驶向西澳大利亚州的小镇格林诺奇。

sentences.en: Greenough.
sentences.zh: 格林诺奇。

sentences.en: Ferocious, salty winds from the nearby coastline were once again lashing the dry countryside,
sentences.zh: 来自附近海岸的狂野咸湿海风再次鞭打着干燥的乡村，

sentences.en: the same winds that had left some eucalyptus trees along the floodplains permanently bent at a 90 degree angle.
sentences.zh: 正是这股海风，使得泛滥平原上的一些桉树永久地弯曲成了90度角。

sentences.en: These leaning trees were just one of a few attractions the township had to offer, but it was far from a tourist destination.
sentences.zh: 这些倾斜的树木只是这个城镇仅有的几个景点之一，但这里远算不上什么旅游目的地。

sentences.en: Located 400 kilometres north of the city of Perth, few at the time would have even heard of Greenough or have any reason to visit the quiet and sparsely populated sheep and wheat
sentences.zh: 该镇位于珀斯市以北400公里处，在当时，很少有人听说过格林诺奇，也没有人有理由去访问这个人口稀少、安静的绵羊和小麦

sentences.en: farming community.
sentences.zh: 养殖社区。

sentences.en: Ron and Dina knew the area well, having spent time there with their friend, Karen McKenzie.
sentences.zh: 罗恩和迪娜对这个地区很熟悉，他们曾和朋友卡伦·麦肯齐一起在那里度过时光。

sentences.en: Karen resided in Greenough with her three children, Daniel, Amara and Katrina.
sentences.zh: 卡伦带着她的三个孩子丹尼尔、阿玛拉和卡特里娜住在格林诺奇。

sentences.en: The 31-year-old single mother had recently gotten together enough money to rent a small house
sentences.zh: 这位31岁的单亲妈妈最近攒够了钱，在镇上的农村郊区租了一间小屋，

sentences.en: on the rural outskirts of town, where landmarks and homesteads were few and far between.
sentences.zh: 那里地标和宅基地稀少，相距甚远。

sentences.en: Their modest, cream-coloured weatherboard house stood alone among the windswept wild grass, partially framed by dense bushland.
sentences.zh: 他们简朴的米色木板房孤零零地矗立在被风吹拂的野草之中，四周部分环绕着茂密的灌木丛。

sentences.en: Despite the isolation of the area, Karen was working hard to build a good life for herself and her kids.
sentences.zh: 尽管这里偏僻孤立，但卡伦一直在努力为自己和孩子们创造美好的生活。

sentences.en: Ron and Dina had set out for the McKenzie property that morning to help Karen with some home repairs.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，罗恩和迪娜出发前往麦肯齐的住所，去帮卡伦做一些房屋修缮工作。

sentences.en: They drove along Greenough's main street before turning down Georgina Road, a long, unmarked stretch that cut inland between acres of paddocks.
sentences.zh: 他们开车沿着格林诺奇的主街行驶，然后拐入乔治娜路，这是一段长长的、没有路标的道路，在成片的牧场之间向内陆延伸。

sentences.en: Soon, Ron and Dina reached the turn-off to the McKenzie property and pulled up to the house.
sentences.zh: 很快，罗恩和迪娜到达了通往麦肯齐住所的岔路口，并在房子前停下了车。

sentences.en: They could hear the family's pet dog barking wildly from inside the house.
sentences.zh: 他们能听到家里宠物狗在屋里疯狂地吠叫。

sentences.en: But other than that, everything was eerily quiet.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，四周死一般的寂静。

sentences.en: The wind batted several lines of washing strung up in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 风拍打着后院挂着的几排洗好的衣物。

sentences.en: But there was no movement from within the house, and nobody came out to greet them.
sentences.zh: 但屋里没有任何动静，也没有人出来迎接他们。

sentences.en: The state of the house seemed inconsequential to what Ron and Dina spotted upon arriving.
sentences.zh: 房子的状况与罗恩和迪娜到达时看到的情景相比显得微不足道。

sentences.en: Someone was lying motionless on the driveway.
sentences.zh: 有人一动不动地躺在车道上。

sentences.en: It looked like Daniel, Karen's 16-year-old son.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是丹尼尔，卡伦16岁的儿子。

sentences.en: Assuming the teen might be playing some kind of prank, Ron got out to see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 罗恩以为这个十几岁的男孩可能在搞什么恶作剧，便下车查看情况。

sentences.en: Ron called out for Karen, but there was no reply.
sentences.zh: 罗恩大声呼喊卡伦，但没有任何回应。

sentences.en: He tentatively walked towards the person lying in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 他试探性地走向躺在车道上的人。

sentences.en: As he got closer, a wave of horror washed over him.
sentences.zh: 当他走近时，一股恐惧感向他袭来。

sentences.en: From inside the car, Dina became hysterical and screamed for her husband to get back in.
sentences.zh: 车里的迪娜情绪崩溃了，尖叫着让丈夫回去。

sentences.en: Ron ran and leapt into the driver's seat, slamming the door behind him.
sentences.zh: 罗恩跑过去跳进驾驶座，砰的一声关上车门。

sentences.en: He grasped the wheel and pressed his foot down on the accelerator.
sentences.zh: 他紧紧抓住方向盘，一脚踩下油门。

sentences.en: The couple sped off back down the driveway, leaving a cloud of dust in their wake.
sentences.zh: 两人沿着车道疾驰而去，留下一团尘土。

sentences.en: The closest neighbour was a few hundred metres away.
sentences.zh: 最近的邻居在几百米外。

sentences.en: Ron parked on the road, jumped the fence, and raced towards the house, frantically yelling and waving.
sentences.zh: 罗恩把车停在路上，翻过栅栏，朝着房子跑去，一边疯狂地呼喊和挥手。

sentences.en: But nobody was home.
sentences.zh: 但家里没有人。

sentences.en: He did the same at the next property, but no one was home there either.
sentences.zh: 他在下一处房产也做了同样的事，但那里也没有人。

sentences.en: Ron rushed back to his car and sped up the main gravel road to the first house he came across, only to find that it too was empty.
sentences.zh: 罗恩冲回车里，沿着主砂石路疾驰到他遇到的第一栋房子，却发现那里也是空的。

sentences.en: Ron rushed in and asked to use their phone to call the police.
sentences.zh: 罗恩冲进去请求借用他们的电话报警。

sentences.en: He needed to report a murder.
sentences.zh: 他需要报告一起谋杀案。

sentences.en: Although he suspected the body on the Mackenzie's driveway was Daniel, he couldn't be sure.
sentences.zh: 虽然他怀疑麦肯齐车道上的尸体是丹尼尔，但他不能确定。

sentences.en: The person was so badly maimed that their face was unrecognisable.
sentences.zh: 那个人被残害得如此严重，以至于面目全非。

sentences.en: Although Grenfell is considered to be a bit of a ghost town, the major city of Geraldton is just 24 kilometres north.
sentences.zh: 虽然格伦费尔被认为有点像鬼城，但主要城市杰拉尔顿就在北边24公里处。

sentences.en: As the largest city north of Perth, Geraldton has many features that put it on the map,
sentences.zh: 作为珀斯以北最大的城市，杰拉尔顿拥有许多让它闻名遐迩的特色，

sentences.en: including a thriving fishing industry, stunning spring wildflowers, and sprawling surf beaches.
sentences.zh: 包括繁荣的渔业、迷人的春季野花和绵延的冲浪海滩。

sentences.en: Near 60 kilometres offshore are Pelsat, Easter, and Wallaby Islands, key locations of the deadly Batavia shipwreck, covered in episode 138 of Case File.
sentences.zh: 离岸约60公里处是佩尔萨特、东部和瓦拉比群岛，这里是致命的巴达维亚号沉船事件的关键地点，档案第138期对此进行了报道。

sentences.en: For many travellers, Geraldton is their main destination, with isolated towns like Grenfell acting as stop places along the way.
sentences.zh: 对许多旅行者来说，杰拉尔顿是他们的主要目的地，像格伦费尔这样偏远的城镇则是沿途的中转站。

sentences.en: However, in the late summer of 1993, Grenfell would surpass the city in making headlines.
sentences.zh: 然而，在1993年的夏末，格伦费尔在登上头条新闻方面将超越这座城市。

sentences.en: The unassuming and little-known township was propelled into the national spotlight for what came to be called one of the worst crimes in Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 这个不起眼且鲜为人知的小镇因为被称为西澳大利亚最严重的犯罪之一而成为全国瞩目的焦点。

sentences.en: For that reason, Grenfell was put on the map.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，格伦费尔才得以名声大噪。

sentences.en: It had been a typical morning at Geraldton's Criminal Investigation Bureau on February 22 1993,
sentences.zh: 1993年2月22日，杰拉尔顿犯罪调查局迎来了一个平常的早晨，

sentences.en: when detectives received news that a brutalised body had been found outside a residence in Sleepy Grenfell.
sentences.zh: 当时侦探们接到消息称，在沉睡的格伦费尔的一处住宅外发现了一具惨遭虐杀的尸体。

sentences.en: Forensic Inspector Bryn Jones and Detective Merv Cousins, along with a team of uniformed officers,
sentences.zh: 法医检查官布林·琼斯和侦探默夫·考辛斯，以及一队制服警官，

sentences.en: immediately made the 16-minute drive down the Bruce Highway, arriving at the McKenzie property around 11am.
sentences.zh: 立即沿着布鲁斯高速公路驱车16分钟，于上午11点左右抵达麦肯齐住所。

sentences.en: As reported, a blood-soaked body lay in the dust just outside the homestead, having been so savagely attacked that their face was indistinguishable.
sentences.zh: 据报道，一具血迹斑斑的尸体躺在宅邸外的尘土中，由于遭受了极其野蛮的袭击，其面部已经无法辨认。

sentences.en: The victim was identified as 16-year-old Daniel, the oldest of Karen McKenzie's three children.
sentences.zh: 死者被确认是16岁的丹尼尔，他是卡伦·麦肯齐三个孩子中的老大。

sentences.en: Her other two children, daughters 7-year-old Amara and 5-year-old Katrina, were nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 她的另外两个孩子，7岁的女儿阿玛拉和5岁的女儿卡特里娜，不见踪影。

sentences.en: Karen, too, was missing.
sentences.zh: 卡伦也失踪了。

sentences.en: The detectives turned their attention to the house before them.
sentences.zh: 侦探们将注意力转向眼前的房子。

sentences.en: The family's pet dog continued to bark from within towards a rear door.
sentences.zh: 家里的宠物狗继续从屋内朝着后门狂吠。

sentences.en: The detectives were rattled.
sentences.zh: 侦探们感到震惊。

sentences.en: Was Daniel's killer still at the scene?
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔的凶手还在现场吗？

sentences.en: Unwilling to take any chances, they raised their handguns before entering the property.
sentences.zh: 为了稳妥起见，他们举起手枪进入了宅邸。

sentences.en: Nothing could prepare them for what they found inside.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能让他们为里面发现的一切做好心理准备。

sentences.en: The lounge room was in complete disarray.
sentences.zh: 客厅里一片狼藉。

sentences.en: Among the clothing and other items that had been strewn about,
sentences.zh: 在散落的衣物和其他物品中，

sentences.en: Karen McKenzie lay face down on the floor, her head covered with a blood-soaked blanket.
sentences.zh: 卡伦·麦肯齐面朝下躺在地板上，她的头上盖着一条血迹斑斑的毯子。

sentences.en: It was clear that she was deceased, having sustained numerous blows to her head and body, similar to those unleashed on her son outside.
sentences.zh: 很明显她已经死亡，头部和身体受到了多次重击，类似于外面她儿子所遭受的攻击。

sentences.en: She'd also been positioned in such a way that indicated she had been raped post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 她的摆放姿势还表明她曾遭到死后奸淫。

sentences.en: The detectives continued deeper into the house.
sentences.zh: 侦探们继续深入屋内。

sentences.en: Upon reaching one of the bedrooms, they found the bodies of 7-year-old Amara and 5-year-old Katrina.
sentences.zh: 走到其中一间卧室时，他们发现了7岁阿玛拉和5岁卡特里娜的尸体。

sentences.en: Like their brother and mother before them, both had been hacked to death.
sentences.zh: 就像之前的哥哥和母亲一样，两人都被砍死。

sentences.en: Amara had also been sexually assaulted.
sentences.zh: 阿玛拉也遭到性侵。

sentences.en: Across the country, in the state of Queensland,
sentences.zh: 在全国另一端的昆士兰州，

sentences.en: Evelyn pressed the phone receiver to her ear.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳将电话听筒贴在耳边。

sentences.en: She had lost count of how many times she had dialed her sister Karen's phone number, but each time, the line rang out or occasionally beeped to signal it was engaged.
sentences.zh: 她已经记不清自己拨打姐姐卡伦的电话号码多少次了，但每次都是长音无人接听，或者偶尔发出占线的哔哔声。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, Evelyn had received a word from her brother, who had overheard some shocking news on the radio.
sentences.zh: 那天早些时候，伊芙琳收到了她哥哥的消息，他无意中从收音机里听到了一个令人震惊的消息。

sentences.en: A woman and her three children had been killed in Grenf.
sentences.zh: 一名女子和她的三个孩子在格伦费尔被杀。

sentences.en: Although the victims weren't named, their ages correlated with that of Karen and her three children.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有说出受害者的名字，但他们的年龄与卡伦和她的三个孩子相符。

sentences.en: Interstate, all Evelyn could do was try to reach out to her sister via phone and hope for the beSt.
sentences.zh: 身处外州的伊芙琳能做的只有通过电话联系姐姐，并祈祷一切顺利。

sentences.en: But as her calls continued to go unanswered, her fears increased.
sentences.zh: 但随着她的电话依然无人接听，她的恐惧与日俱增。

sentences.en: She went out with her husband, setting the television up to record the news while they were gone.
sentences.zh: 她和丈夫出了门，设置了电视在他们离开时录制新闻。

sentences.en: When they returned, they watched the footage.
sentences.zh: 他们回来后，观看了录像。

sentences.en: The quadruple homicide making waves in Western Australia was reported, but the details were scant.
sentences.zh: 报道了西澳大利亚发生的这起四人凶杀案，但细节很少。

sentences.en: At this point, Evelyn had no reason to believe the victims were her sister, nephew and nieces.
sentences.zh: 此时，伊芙琳没有理由相信死者是她的姐姐、外甥和外甥女。

sentences.en: But her instincts were telling her otherwise.
sentences.zh: 但她的直觉告诉她并非如此。

sentences.en: Her husband contacted authorities to get answers.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫联系了当局以获取答案。

sentences.en: Evelyn studied his expression as he made the call.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳注视着他打电话时的表情。

sentences.en: When tears started to fall down his face, her worst fears were confirmed.
sentences.zh: 当泪水开始顺着他的脸庞滑落时，她最担心的事被证实了。

sentences.en: Evelyn later stated,
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳后来说道，

sentences.en: Inside the Mackenzie house, the juxtaposition was confronting.
sentences.zh: 在麦肯齐的房子里，这种强烈的对比让人感到震撼。

sentences.en: On one hand, the grisly scene was a living nightmare.
sentences.zh: 一方面，这起骇人听闻的案件宛如人间噩梦。

sentences.en: On the other hand, it was full of all the small details that make a house a home.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，这里又充满了让房子成为之家的各种微小细节。

sentences.en: Toys were scattered throughout, drawings by the children were displayed on the fridge, and to-do lists captured the family's daily life.
sentences.zh: 玩具散落各处，孩子们的画贴在冰箱上，待办事项清单记录着一家的日常生活。

sentences.en: A Christmas wish list from Katrina assured Santa that she had been a good girl, who hoped to receive a troll doll, rollerblades, or a radio for her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 来自卡特里娜的一份圣诞愿望清单向圣诞老人保证她一直是个好女孩，希望能收到一个巨魔娃娃、旱冰鞋或是一台放在卧室里的收音机。

sentences.en: Karen had proudly held on to a handmade card from Amara that wished her a happy Mother's Day.
sentences.zh: 卡伦自豪地保留着一张阿玛拉亲手制作的卡片，上面祝她母亲节快乐。

sentences.en: It was clear that they were a loving and warm family.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这是一个充满爱与温馨的家庭。

sentences.en: But things hadn't always been easy for Karen Mackenzie.
sentences.zh: 但卡伦·麦肯齐的生活并非一帆风顺。

sentences.en: As a child growing up in Queensland, she had a great curiosity for the world and how things worked.
sentences.zh: 作为在昆士兰州长大的一名儿童，她对世界以及事物运作方式有着强烈的好奇心。

sentences.en: She loved nothing more than exploring outdoors and was eager to learn everything she could.
sentences.zh: 她最喜欢在户外探索，渴望了解所能学到的一切。

sentences.en: But, when she hit adolescence, this curiosity led her to experiment with drugs, and at the age of 15, she unexpectedly became pregnant.
sentences.zh: 然而，当她进入青春期时，这种好奇心促使她尝试毒品，并在15岁时意外怀孕。

sentences.en: Karen gave birth to Daniel and was determined to make it as a single mother.
sentences.zh: 卡伦生下了丹尼尔，并决心作为一个单亲妈妈闯出一片天。

sentences.en: She moved out of home and rented her own flat, but the challenges of young parenthood were overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 她搬出家自己租了一套公寓，但年轻父母面临的挑战令人应接不暇。

sentences.en: Karen feared she couldn't give Daniel the life he deserved.
sentences.zh: 卡伦担心自己无法给丹尼尔应得的生活。

sentences.en: So, when he was two years old, she made the difficult decision to let her mother have custody of Daniel full-time.
sentences.zh: 因此，在丹尼尔两岁时，她做出了艰难的决定，让母亲全权抚养丹尼尔。

sentences.en: She then made the move to Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 随后她搬到了西澳大利亚州。

sentences.en: Years later, Karen fell in love with a man named Andrew Allen and they had Amara and Katrina.
sentences.zh: 几年后，卡伦爱上了一个名叫安德鲁·艾伦的男子，并生下了阿玛拉和卡特里娜。

sentences.en: She adored her two girls, but her relationship with Andrew didn't laSt.
sentences.zh: 她疼爱这两个女儿，但她与安德鲁的关系并没有持续多久。

sentences.en: Once again, Karen found herself as a single parent, but this time she was older and wiser and committed to making things work.
sentences.zh: 卡伦再次发现自己成了一名单亲妈妈，但这次她更成熟、更明智，也决心把生活过好。

sentences.en: She moved with her girls to Grenf and reached out to her now teenage son, Daniel, inviting him to come and live with them as a family.
sentences.zh: 她带着女儿们搬到了格伦费尔，并联系了如今已是少年的儿子丹尼尔，邀请他来和她们一起以家庭的方式生活。

sentences.en: He agreed, and Karen was beyond excited.
sentences.zh: 他同意了，卡伦兴奋不已。

sentences.en: She was thrilled to have all her children living under the same roof for the first time.
sentences.zh: 她很高兴能第一次让所有的孩子都住在同一个屋檐下。

sentences.en: It would also give her a bit more independence, as Daniel was also old and responsible enough to babysit his younger sisters.
sentences.zh: 这也将赋予她更多一些的独立性，因为丹尼尔已经足够大且足够懂事，可以帮忙照看年幼的妹妹们。

sentences.en: Daniel was equally looking forward to the change.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔同样对这个改变充满期待。

sentences.en: For his birthday, he asked his grandmother for a bus ticket to Western Australia and made the move the following day.
sentences.zh: 为了过生日，他向祖母要了一张去西澳大利亚的车票，并在第二天搬了过去。

sentences.en: While Daniel had never really enjoyed school and often didn't attend, he enrolled at high school in Geraldton and gave it his beSt.
sentences.zh: 虽然丹尼尔从未真正喜欢过学校且经常旷课，但他在杰拉尔顿的高中注册入学并做出了最大的努力。

sentences.en: Things had been looking bright for the Mackenzie family and they had plenty to look forward to.
sentences.zh: 麦肯齐一家的生活一度呈现出光明的前景，他们有许多值得期待的事情。

sentences.en: For the family of four to be viciously struck down in the midst of building a vibrant and positive life together made very little sense.
sentences.zh: 这个四口之家在共同建立充满活力和积极生活的过程中遭到残忍杀害，这实在让人难以理解。

sentences.en: Inspector Bryn Jones turned to his team and said, I don't care what we do, but we must find the person that did this.
sentences.zh: 布林·琼斯检查官转向他的团队说：“我不在乎我们做什么，但我们必须找到做这件事的人。”

sentences.en: The major crime squad arrived in Grenf from Perth and had to work faSt.
sentences.zh: 重案组从珀斯赶到格伦费尔，必须抓紧时间。

sentences.en: The sun was blazing down on the crime scene and the accompanying strong coastal winds risked disturbing evidence.
sentences.zh: 强烈的阳光炙烤着犯罪现场，伴随而来的沿海强风有破坏证据的风险。

sentences.en: The team spent the remainder of the day and night painstakingly combing the property, determined not to let anything go unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 团队花了当天剩下的时间和整夜时间仔细搜查这处房产，决心不放过任何蛛丝马迹。

sentences.en: It was an exhausting task, both mentally and physically.
sentences.zh: 这是一项令人身心俱疲的任务。

sentences.en: The crime scene was one of the most brutal that attending officers had ever seen, causing several to become physically sick.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场是出警警官见过最残忍的现场之一，导致好几个人当场呕吐。

sentences.en: Others would later change departments or leave that sort of police work entirely.
sentences.zh: 其他人后来选择调离部门或彻底离开这种警察工作。

sentences.en: All would struggle with the memories of what they witnessed that day.
sentences.zh: 所有人都一直在与那天目睹这一切的记忆作斗争。

sentences.en: This extreme reaction offers an explanation as to why the specifics of what happened at the Mackenzie house have been withheld.
sentences.zh: 这种极端的反应解释了为什么麦肯齐家中发生的具体细节一直被隐瞒。

sentences.en: Deemed too traumatic for public knowledge, a rare court-issued suppression order has banned the exact details from ever being reported.
sentences.zh: 由于被认为对公众而言过于创伤，一项罕见的法院禁令禁止报道确切细节。

sentences.en: The information presented in this case file episode is collated from the widely publicised facts.
sentences.zh: 本案档案节目中呈现的信息是从广为人知的事实中收集整理的。

sentences.en: Three days before Karen McKenzie was found murdered, she had attended a house party in Geraldton.
sentences.zh: 在卡伦·麦肯齐被发现遇害的三天前，她曾参加了杰拉尔顿的一个家庭派对。

sentences.en: Daniel had agreed to babysit his two younger sisters, affording his mother a rare and welcome to night out.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔同意照顾他两个年幼的妹妹，让他的母亲度过了一个难得且受欢迎的夜晚外出。

sentences.en: Karen returned home at around 5am on Saturday, receiving a lift home from a friend.
sentences.zh: 卡伦在周六凌晨5点左右回到家，由一位朋友开车送她回家。

sentences.en: A neighbour happened to witness Karen's friend driving away from the house on Saturday, but they didn't see anything suspicious over the following hours.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居碰巧看到卡伦的朋友在周六开车离开这栋房子，但在接下来的几个小时里没有看到任何可疑情况。

sentences.en: The family was targeted on Sunday night.
sentences.zh: 这一家人在周日晚上成为袭击目标。

sentences.en: Karen was asleep on a mattress in the lounge room when she was struck.
sentences.zh: 卡伦遇袭时正睡在客厅的一个床垫上。

sentences.en: Her daughters were then confronted in the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 她的女儿们随后在卧室里遭遇袭击。

sentences.en: It was unclear how Daniel's body came to be outside, though some speculated he'd fled from the house and was chased down by his attacker,
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚丹尼尔的尸体是如何跑到外面的，不过有人推测他可能从屋里逃跑并遭到袭击者的追赶，

sentences.en: before being fatally struck in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 随后在车道上遭到致命袭击。

sentences.en: The murder weapon was nowhere to be found, but based on the victim's injuries, it appeared their killer had been wielding either an axe, a tomahawk or meat cleaver.
sentences.zh: 凶器下落不明，但根据受害者的伤势，凶手似乎使用的是斧头、短斧或肉锤。

sentences.en: Many foreign fingerprints were found throughout the home, but the challenge was ruling out who they belonged to.
sentences.zh: 屋里发现了许多陌生指纹，但难点在于排除这些指纹属于谁。

sentences.en: Semen was also detected, but DNA technology was still in its infancy, and this couldn't be used to identify who was responsible.
sentences.zh: 还检测出了精液，但DNA技术仍处于起步阶段，无法用其来确定谁是凶手。

sentences.en: Grenf's community were left shocked by the murders.
sentences.zh: 格伦费尔的社区对这些谋杀案感到震惊。

sentences.en: Although Geraldton City and its surrounding region had its share of drug and theft-related offences, crimes of this magnitude were unheard of.
sentences.zh: 尽管杰尔顿市及其周边地区也曾发生过毒品和盗窃相关的犯罪，但如此规模的罪行还是前所未闻。

sentences.en: Without a clear motive or suspect for the slayings, the township was gripped by fear that the unknown, sadistic killer would strike again.
sentences.zh: 由于凶案既没有明确的动机，也没有嫌疑人，整个镇子陷入了极度的恐慌，生怕那个未知的、虐待狂般的杀手再次行凶。

sentences.en: No one could understand why anyone would want to hurt Karen and her kids, especially in such a violent and deranged way.
sentences.zh: 没有人能理解为什么会有人想要伤害凯伦和她的孩子们，尤其还是用如此暴力和疯狂的方式。

sentences.en: The police didn't say too much as they didn't want to cause any unnecessary alarm.
sentences.zh: 警方没有透露太多信息，因为他们不想引起不必要的恐慌。

sentences.en: They simply warned the community to take proper safety measures.
sentences.zh: 他们只是警告社区居民采取适当的安全措施。

sentences.en: While it was possible that the killings were a random attack, this didn't appear to be the case.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些凶杀案也可能是随机袭击，但目前看来并非如此。

sentences.en: To get to the Mackenzie House, you had to exit the highway and travel a fair distance down a remote side street.
sentences.zh: 要前往麦肯齐宅邸，你必须驶离高速公路，沿着一条偏僻的支路开行一段相当长的距离。

sentences.en: There was nothing out there besides a few houses spread throughout the dry, rural flatlands.
sentences.zh: 在那荒凉平坦的旱地上，除了零星几栋房屋外，别无他物。

sentences.en: The only reason to be in the area was to visit one of these residences.
sentences.zh: 来到这一带的唯一理由就是拜访这些住宅中的某一套。

sentences.en: It wasn't the kind of place an opportunistic killer would have stumbled across in their everyday travels.
sentences.zh: 这里绝不是那种机会主义杀手在日常出行中会偶然路过的地方。

sentences.en: They had to be familiar not only with Grenf, but its outskirts.
sentences.zh: 凶手不仅必须熟悉格伦夫，还要熟悉它的郊区。

sentences.en: It seemed they had set out on Georgina Road on that Sunday night with every intention of attacking the Mackenzie family.
sentences.zh: 似乎他们在那个周日晚上出发走上乔治娜路时，就已怀揣着袭击麦肯齐一家的明确意图。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案案卷稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持“档案案卷”继续为您提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Phone records from the Mackenzie property revealed that a call had been placed to the house at 11.15, the night of the killings.
sentences.zh: 麦肯齐宅邸的通话记录显示，在命案当晚的11点15分，曾有人向该住宅拨打过一通电话。

sentences.en: The caller was identified as a man who had previously lived at their property.
sentences.zh: 经查证，来电者是一名曾在这处房产居住过的男子。

sentences.en: He admitted to speaking to Karen at this time, but for innocent reasons.
sentences.zh: 他承认自己在此时与凯伦通过话，但纯粹是出于无辜的原因。

sentences.en: He claimed he went to bed straight after making the call.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己打完电话后就直接上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: After police established a tip line, the pool of potential suspects grew quickly.
sentences.zh: 在警方设立了热线电话后，潜在的嫌疑人范围迅速扩大。

sentences.en: There was Karen's former partner, Andrew Allen, who was the father to Amara and Katrina.
sentences.zh: 首先是凯伦的前伴侣安德鲁·艾伦，他是阿马拉和卡特里娜的父亲。

sentences.en: He had contacted police after hearing about the murders on the news and was tracked down to Halls Creek, a small outback town over 2,000 kilometres northeast of Grenf.
sentences.zh: 他在新闻上得知谋杀案后联系了警方，警方最终在霍尔斯克里克追踪到了他的踪迹——那是位于格伦夫东北方向2000多公里外的一个偏远内陆小镇。

sentences.en: Andrew maintained that he'd been stuck in Halls Creek during the time of the murders due to heavy rainfall that had flooded the roads leading in and out of town.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁坚称，由于大雨导致进出镇子的道路被淹，他在谋杀发生期间一直被困在霍尔斯克里克。

sentences.en: Then there was Shane Eastoff, a man Karen had been seeing shortly before her murder.
sentences.zh: 还有肖恩·伊斯托夫，这是凯伦在遇害前不久一直在交往的一个男人。

sentences.en: He told police that Karen had recently broken things off between them out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警方，凯伦最近突然单方面和他断绝了关系。

sentences.en: Then, a few days before the murders,
sentences.zh: 接着，在谋杀案发生几天前，

sentences.en: Shane received an anonymous Valentine's Day card featuring Karen's handwriting.
sentences.zh: 肖恩收到了一张匿名的情人节贺卡，上面有凯伦的笔迹。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: In the bottom left-hand corner of the card,
sentences.zh: 在贺卡的左下角，

sentences.en: Karen had signed off with the word,
sentences.zh: 凯伦署上了这样几个字：

sentences.en: In hindsight,
sentences.zh: 事后回想起来，

sentences.en: Shane wondered whether this indicated that Karen knew something bad was about to happen.
sentences.zh: 肖恩不禁琢磨，这是否表明凯伦当时就知道有什么不好的事情即将发生。

sentences.en: Then there was the sighting of two vehicles leaving the Mackenzie property on the night of the murders.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有目击者称在谋杀案当晚看到两辆车离开麦肯齐宅邸。

sentences.en: The witness hadn't seen either of the cars before and didn't know who they belonged to.
sentences.zh: 这名目击者以前从未见过这两辆车，也不知道它们属于谁。

sentences.en: This was just one of many unsubstantiated tips that served to further muddy the already perplexing investigation.
sentences.zh: 这只是众多未经证实的小道消息之一，反而让这起本就令人费解的调查变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: There was also the suggestion that the crime could be drug-related, as Karen was known to use recreationally and associate with other drug users
sentences.zh: 还有一种说法认为这起犯罪可能与毒品有关，因为众所周知凯伦平时有吸毒习惯，且与其他人有过交往，

sentences.en: and individuals linked to the cannabis trade.
sentences.zh: 其中包括与大麻交易有关的人员。

sentences.en: The city of Geraldton was a known sea passage that facilitated drug trafficking from Asia to Australia.
sentences.zh: 杰尔顿市是一条著名的海上通道，便利了毒品从亚洲向澳大利亚的走私。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the party Karen attended on the Friday night before her murder involved drug use.
sentences.zh: 此外，凯伦在遇害前的周五晚上参加的那场派对也牵涉到吸毒。

sentences.en: Those affiliated with the illicit scene typically kept a safe distance from police.
sentences.zh: 那些与非法圈子有牵连的人通常会与警方保持安全距离。

sentences.en: But the murders had rocked the community so much that most people were willing to talk.
sentences.zh: 但这次谋杀案对社区的震动实在太大，以至于大多数人都愿意开口协助调查。

sentences.en: Bikeies and other gangs that were active in the area were looked into, but the police couldn't find anything worthwhile to their investigations.
sentences.zh: 警方对活跃在当地的飞车党和其他帮派进行了调查，但并未查出对案件有价值的线索。

sentences.en: However, they couldn't rule out that the crimes could be drug-related in some way.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们无法排除这起犯罪在某种程度上与毒品有关的可能性。

sentences.en: Then, a witness came forward having seen Karen in Geraldton on the Sunday morning before the attack.
sentences.zh: 随后，一名目击者站出来称，在袭击发生前的周日早晨，他曾在杰尔顿看到过凯伦。

sentences.en: She had been speaking to a fisherman who was working in the area at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时她正在和一个当时在当地工作的渔夫交谈。

sentences.en: Police looked into the fisherman and discovered that he had left Geraldton for the city of Darwin in the neighbouring state of the Northern Territory the day the bodies were found.
sentences.zh: 警方对这名渔夫展开调查，发现在发现尸体的当天，他就已经离开杰尔顿，前往邻近的北领地首府达尔文市。

sentences.en: They tracked him down, only to find that he had no alibi for the night of the murders.
sentences.zh: 警方顺藤摸瓜找到了他，却发现他没有案发当晚的不在场证明。

sentences.en: By now,
sentences.zh: 截至此时，

sentences.en: 70 persons of interest had emerged throughout the Grenf and Geraldton regions and interstate.
sentences.zh: 格伦夫、杰尔顿及外州地区已经出现了70名涉案嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Police continued to speculate possible motives, but they were plagued by uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 警方继续推测各种可能的作案动机，但始终被重重谜团所困扰。

sentences.en: The sheer brutality of the attack using a handheld bludgeon indicated that the perpetrator was compelled by something personal, such as revenge.
sentences.zh: 袭击中使用手持钝器表现出的极度残忍，表明凶手是受到某种私人恩怨（如复仇）的驱使。

sentences.en: Yet, the necrophilia and child sexual assault indicated something else entirely.
sentences.zh: 然而，奸尸和儿童性侵的行为又指向了完全不同的方向。

sentences.en: While a motive and suspect eluded them, police did uncover one major clue.
sentences.zh: 尽管动机和嫌疑人依然成谜，但警方确实发现了一条重要线索。

sentences.en: While carrying out the crimes, the Mackenzie family killer pressed his right hand against an interior wall.
sentences.zh: 麦肯齐一家的凶手在行凶时，曾将右手按在一面内墙上。

sentences.en: His palm was smeared with an oily substance which left a partial palm print.
sentences.zh: 他的手掌上沾满了油性物质，留下了一个部分掌印。

sentences.en: In the same room, there were three oily fingertip prints on the edge of a door.
sentences.zh: 在同一个房间里，门边缘处有三个油性指尖印。

sentences.en: These markings appeared to have been made as the killer closed the door behind them.
sentences.zh: 这些痕迹似乎是凶手在随手关门时留下的。

sentences.en: The section of wall containing the palm print was cut out and taken away for examination.
sentences.zh: 留有掌印的那段墙壁被切割下来并带走进行检测。

sentences.en: The fingerprints were less viable as the door had originally been painted with a coarse paintbrush using rough strokes.
sentences.zh: 由于这扇门原本是用粗毛刷以粗糙的手法粉刷过，指纹的可用性相对较低。

sentences.en: Still, investigators removed the entire door so it too could undergo forensic testing.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，调查人员还是拆下了整扇门，以便对其进行法医鉴定。

sentences.en: At the Western Australia
sentences.zh: 在西澳大利亚州

sentences.en: Chem Centre in Perth, a chief research chemist and his team got to work testing the oily prints.
sentences.zh: 珀斯的化学中心，一位首席研究化学家和他的团队开始着手检测这些油性印记。

sentences.en: Given that they weren't full fingerprints, their best bet was to identify what the oily substance was.
sentences.zh: 鉴于它们并非完整的指纹，他们最好的对策是先弄清楚这种油性物质究竟是什么。

sentences.en: The team concluded the print had been made using a sorbelene-like substance, which is a common type of hand lotion.
sentences.zh: 研究小组得出结论，该印记是用一种类似索贝林（sorbelene）的物质留下的，这是一种常见的护手霜。

sentences.en: But they couldn't be sure exactly what the product was.
sentences.zh: 但他们无法确定这具体是哪种产品。

sentences.en: The Chem Centre kept a catalogue of approximately
sentences.zh: 化学中心现场保存了一个包含大约

sentences.en: 80 different hand and body lotions on site.
sentences.zh: 80种不同手部和身体乳液的目录。

sentences.en: The substance was tested against each one, but no match was found.
sentences.zh: 他们用每一种乳液与该物质进行对比测试，但没有找到匹配项。

sentences.en: The team then gathered all the various lotions present in the McKenzie household and tested the substance against those.
sentences.zh: 随后，研究小组收集了麦肯齐家中所有的各种乳液，并用这些乳液对该物质进行了测试。

sentences.en: But they couldn't find a match there either.
sentences.zh: 但他们同样没有在那里找到匹配的乳液。

sentences.en: The last time
sentences.zh: 杰尔顿居民

sentences.en: Geraldton resident
sentences.zh: 哈米什·兰福德（化名）

sentences.en: Hamish Langford, not his real name, saw Karen McKenzie was at the house party he'd hosted three days before she was killed.
sentences.zh: 最后一次见到凯伦·麦肯齐，是在他遇害前三天主办的那场家庭派对上。

sentences.en: As the murder investigation gained pace,
sentences.zh: 随着谋杀案调查的深入，

sentences.en: Hamish returned home to find a ghastly scene.
sentences.zh: 哈米什回到家中，却看到了一幕可怕的景象。

sentences.en: His house had been broken into and there was a significant amount of blood on the floor.
sentences.zh: 他的房子遭到了破门入室，地板上有大量的血迹。

sentences.en: Panicked,
sentences.zh: 惊慌失措之下，

sentences.en: Hamish phoned the police who quickly arrived at the scene.
sentences.zh: 哈米什报警，警方很快赶到了现场。

sentences.en: The amount of blood indicated someone had been seriously injured and police feared the McKenzie family murderer had struck again.
sentences.zh: 血迹的数量表明有人受了重伤，警方担心麦肯齐一家的凶手再次作案了。

sentences.en: As they considered this, the back door of Hamish's home flung open.
sentences.zh: 正当他们思索时，哈米什家的后门猛地被推开了。

sentences.en: Standing in the doorway was a naked man with a blood-soaked towel wrapped around his waiSt.
